reason: It does not fit. In the default build (GAMEPLAY_SHIELD=0) sky_edges.6502 sits at the end of bank 4's under-ANDY part, and src/main.6502 checks that with ASSERT * <= &9000 + PAD_START before the SKIP up to the renderer at &9000. The listing (build/strykers.lst) has sky_col_zero ending with its RTS at &8FE2, so only 29 bytes are free (&8FE3-&8FFF). The new code is 51 bytes against the old 13 (LDA abs,X 3, EOR# 2, BEQ 2, LDA# 2, loop 7, epilogue 6, fast path 8x2 + 7x1 + 6 = 29), a growth of 38 that would end at &9009. The ASSERT fails, so neither the shipping build nor the bench layout (-Shift 256 -ShiftEnd, which also has PAD_START = 0) assembles. Without the ASSERT, the fast path's last bytes would land on render.6502 at &9000. The candidate's 'free SKIP after sky_edges' and its 'straddles &9000 (free)' are both wrong: &9000 is the renderer's start, in the same bank. The cycle count itself checks out on the 65SC12: an 8-byte row is 4+2+3+62 = 71 against 111, saving 40; other rows cost 10 more; sky_rn is at &BCA2 with X < 12, so no page crossing. But a candidate that cannot be built is refuted.
